style.name: Swiss Editorial
style.summary: A disciplined grid with a decisive typographic lead.
layout: Use asymmetric columns with aligned edges.
Let one headline establish the entry point.
motion: Use short transitions to communicate state changes, not to delay tasks.
Honor prefers-reduced-motion and provide immediate feedback.
guidance: Use a clear grid rather than decorative containers.
Use captions and rules to connect related content.
avoid: Do not substitute decorative novelty for task clarity.
Do not apply this direction over an established design system without explicit redesign intent.
